verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Paperspace Workflows automate ML pipelines and that machines can auto-shut down after inactivity, but nothing documents scheduling a job or workflow to run on a recurring basis (cron, timed triggers). Workflows are a one-off automation primitive and auto-shutdown is an adjacent inactivity control; neither is a recurring schedule, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
